en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historicist building with ornate façade signage reading "AUTO HALLE" at the top and "Hotel Goldne Sonne" over the main arched entrance. Ground‑floor signs advertise theater, cinema (Kammer‑Lichtspiele), restaurant, café, and auto‑garage. A cobblestone square lies in front, with hedges and small trees enclosing the terrace. Behind and to the right rises a tall medieval‑looking tower and castle‑like structure on a hill, suggesting an old town setting.
